Container.Name: stasharr-tagger
Container.Overview: Stasharr Tagger (CPU). Looks at frames from your Stasharr scenes and recognises what is happening, so Stasharr can suggest markers. Runs on the processor. If you have an NVIDIA card, install the stasharr-tagger-nvidia template instead: it is many times faster.[br][br]After it starts, open Stasharr → Settings → AI markers and enter http://[your server IP]:2705 as the tagger address. The first start downloads the model (about 600 MB) into the Models folder.

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: Where the downloaded model is kept, so it is only downloaded once.

Config.Name: CPU threads
Config.Description: How many processor threads it may use. More is faster but leaves less for everything else.

Config.Name: Model
Config.Description: OpenCLIP model. ViT-B-32 is quick on a CPU; ViT-L-14 is more accurate but about 8 times slower.

Config.Name: Model weights
Config.Description: Weights for the model. Use laion2b_s32b_b82k with ViT-L-14.
